description: This file defines the CellFont class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading Excel XLS files and handling font styling such as escapement and underline.

classes.name: CellFont
classes.description: Provides static methods to modify font properties such as escapement (superscript/subscript) and underline style within XLS file parsing.

methods.name: escapement
methods.description: Sets the font's escapement to superscript or subscript based on the provided value.

methods.name: underline
methods.description: Sets the underline style of the font based on the provided underline code.
